entities.name: Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Iraq Region
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The Arab Socialist Baath Party – Iraq Region, the Iraqi branch of the pan-Arab Baath Party, which seized power in a 1968 coup and ruled Iraq until the 2003 US invasion, was the governing party of Saddam Hussein's totalitarian state — responsible for the mass murder of Kurds (Anfal campaign, 1986-1989, killing 50,000-182,000 Kurds including chemical weapons attacks at Halabja killing 5,000 in one day), the suppression of Shia uprisings, the Iran-Iraq War (1980-1988), the invasion of Kuwait (1990), and the Gulf War's aftermath.

The Iraqi Baath Party came to power in the July 17 Revolution (1968), initially under Ahmad Hassan al-Bakr before Saddam Hussein consolidated personal control in 1979. Saddam's rule transformed the Baath Party from an ideological pan-Arab socialist movement into a personal despotism using Baathist structures as instruments of control. The party's ideology — combining Arab nationalism, secularism, and socialism — was progressively subordinated to Saddam's cult of personality and tribal-clan power networks centered on Tikrit.

The 2003 US invasion toppled Saddam; the Coalition Provisional Authority's 'de-Baathification' policy (dismissing all Baath Party members from government, security forces, and state enterprises) is widely considered a catastrophic error that created the unemployment and grievance pool recruited by the subsequent Sunni insurgency and eventually by ISIS. The Iraqi Baath Party's legacy directly shaped the sectarian civil war that followed, making it one of the most consequential political parties in modern Middle Eastern history.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Iraqi Baath Party — presiding over the Anfal genocide, Iran-Iraq War, Kuwait invasion, and three decades of totalitarian rule, and whose dissolution via de-Baathification directly fed the insurgency and ISIS — is one of the most destructive political parties in 20th-century history, reshaping the entire Middle East.
